title: Frame Description Entry
description: Single Figma frame description entry. SPEC-FIGMA-001 v0.1.0. Persona tag membership for each field is encoded inline within its description using the canonical marker [persona_tags: <comma-list>] per spec.md section 4.1.

screen_id.description: Unique screen identifier within a manifest. ASCII upper-case identifier, 2 to 64 chars total. [persona_tags: pm, designer, dev, qa]

display_id.description: Display surface identifier, may equal screen_id when there is a single display. [persona_tags: pm, designer, dev, qa]

title.description: Human-readable frame title. UTF-8, no language enforcement at schema level. [persona_tags: pm, designer, dev, qa]

intent.description: One-line summary of the frame's intent. PM-facing free text in project language. Empty string allowed when SPEC-FIGMA-003 anti-hallucination (REQ-09) blanks the field. [persona_tags: pm, designer, dev, qa]

user_value.description: User value statement: what the user gains from this screen. Empty string allowed when SPEC-FIGMA-003 anti-hallucination (REQ-09) blanks the field. PM review and retrospective surface. [persona_tags: pm]

success_criteria.description: Acceptance criterion observable by PM. Empty string allowed when SPEC-FIGMA-003 anti-hallucination (REQ-09) blanks the field. PM review and retrospective surface. [persona_tags: pm]

states.description: Enumerated visual or behavioral states (loading, empty, error, populated, etc.). [persona_tags: qa, dev]

edge_cases.description: Edge cases and exceptional flows for QA scenario authoring and Dev branch coverage. [persona_tags: qa, dev]

component_refs.description: References to design system components or code components used by the frame. Implementation entry point. [persona_tags: dev]

data_io.description: Data inputs and outputs (API calls, props, events). Implementation entry point. [persona_tags: dev]

design_tokens.description: Design tokens applied (color, spacing, typography). Design system change-detection surface. [persona_tags: designer]

variants.description: Component or layout variants in use. Design system change-detection surface. [persona_tags: designer]

navigation.description: Navigation targets and entry transitions for this frame. [persona_tags: pm, designer, dev, qa]

confidence.description: Generator confidence score in the closed interval [0.0, 1.0]. Review-routing signal. [persona_tags: pm, designer]

intent_mismatch.description: True when generator detected a likely intent mismatch (designer escalation flag). Review-routing signal. [persona_tags: pm, designer]

source_hash.description: Lower-case hex digest of the source frame inputs. Algorithm is defined by SPEC-FIGMA-002. Operator metadata for staleness detection. [persona_tags: pm]

write_target.description: Surface the description should be written back to. Operator metadata. [persona_tags: pm]

persona_tags.description: Per-frame audience tags asserted by the producer. Schema-level persona membership for each field is encoded inline in field descriptions per spec.md section 4.1. Operator metadata. [persona_tags: pm]

input_tokens.description: Input tokens consumed by the generator for this frame. Telemetry slot; budget enforcement is SPEC-FIGMA-003.

output_tokens.description: Output tokens produced by the generator for this frame. Telemetry slot; budget enforcement is SPEC-FIGMA-003.

token_usage.description: Generator token telemetry. Operator metadata. [persona_tags: pm]

stale.description: True when source_hash differs from the baseline manifest entry for the same screen_id (REQ-05). Operator metadata. [persona_tags: pm]
stale.$comment: stale derivation field per REQ-05; persona group: operator metadata (extension of spec.md § 4)

review_status.description: Post-hoc review state set by SPEC-FIGMA-003 prompt-injection detector. 'pending_review' marks an entry the detector flagged as suspect; the entry is retained for PM audit rather than dropped. Optional, additive in v0.2.0. [persona_tags: pm]
